basis: Per-video prices. Sources in research/niches/ugc.json. The pack never states what a member will earn.

new.label: New (no paid clips yet)
new.note: Inside the $75 to $150 beginner range (Elev8or) and the $50 to $400 range (Insense).

some.label: 3 or more paid clips
some.note: Top of the beginner range once you have paid work to show.

pro.label: 10 or more paid clips and ad results the brand shared
pro.note: Mid range in Insense's $50 to $400 spread.

addons.label: Extra hook (new first 3 seconds)
addons.note: Judgment: about a third of a new base price.

addons.label: Raw footage (all takes)
addons.note: 30 to 50 percent of base (rate-card articles, search result excerpt).

addons.label: Paid ad use, 30 days
addons.note: Clipspeed: 25 to 50 percent of base per platform for a 30 to 90 day term.

addons.label: Paid ad use, 90 days
addons.note: Two 30-day blocks at a small discount (judgment).

addons.label: Whitelisting or Spark Ads, 30 days
addons.note: Insense: $100 to $150 a month per platform.

bundle.label: Monthly bundle
bundle.note: 4 videos a month, each 10 percent off, billed at the start of the month. Judgment from retainer outlines in the research file.
